final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), rated AS (SELECT avg_length, per_day_price, AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS cross_rating_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS average_length, AVG(per_day_price) AS average_per_day_price, AVG(per_day_price - cross_rating_mean) AS average_excess FROM rated WHERE per_day_price > cross_rating_mean
